project.name: TBS ERP → Workplace Platform — Frontend UI

database_schema.summary: Frontend client — no database. All state from NestJS Backend via REST + WebSocket.
database_schema.relationships_explained: Server state via TanStack Query in src/lib/hooks/. WebSocket via Socket.IO for real-time chat, presence, notifications.

api_endpoints.explained: Chat API: conversations, messages, channels, reactions, search

business_rules: Component phải bám theo Design Spec (HSL colors, shadcn typography)
Spinner khi useQuery isLoading === true, Skeleton cho complex views
Response thường gói trong PaginatedResponse — extract data.data
features: Nhập Hàng Quốc Tế & Hải Quan
Chat / Messenger (EXPANDING — channels, threads, reactions, files)
Drive / Tài liệu (NEW — file browser, upload, preview, share)
Bảng tin Công ty (NEW — news feed, reactions, comments)
Mobile PWA (NEW — bottom nav, push, offline)

patterns: CSR/SSR Server Actions Pattern in Next.js
TanStack Query invalidation on WebSocket events
gotchas: Luôn kiểm tra Map Array Type khi sử dụng API Phân trang
Next.js App router: 'use client' ở đầu file hooks/components
Socket.IO client must reconnect after JWT refresh
PWA service worker caching conflicts with tanstack-query — use runtime caching only for API
conventions: File naming: PascalCase components, kebab-case routes

upcoming_pages./tro-chuyen: Chat — ChatSidebar, MessageList, ComposeBar, ThreadPanel, EmojiPicker, MentionAutocomplete
upcoming_pages./tai-lieu: Drive — FileGrid, FileList, UploadDropzone, FilePreview, ShareDialog, DriveSidebar
upcoming_pages./bang-tin: Bulletin — PostFeed, PostCard, ComposePost, ReactionBar, CommentSection
